summary:
Phase P4 adds terminal-side animation playback and accessibility surfacing to TGP, layered on the scene model (S06), asset/GLB import + acks (S08), the wire/error framing + apc_end back-channel, and the deterministic injectable clock + CPU picking/event emission from the interactivity phase (S12). It is split into 14 dependency-ordered tasks.

Scope delivered:
1. Accessibility (S13): `alt` field on nodes/scene/viewports, bounded validation (UTF-8, ≤max_id_bytes-class cap, no control/ESC), `alt`-only upserts bump no revision, terminal surfacing as accessible name + cell-fallback caption resolved through the CPU pick path.
2. glTF clip import (S14.1): parse glTF animation channels (STEP/LINEAR/CUBICSPLINE TRS keyframes) on asset.add commit, store AnimationClips, auto-register one ClipId per glTF animation, return the glTF-anim-index→ClipId mapping in the asset's `a` ack.
3. The `anim` control frame family (S14.3): play/pause/seek/stop verbs on the deterministic clock, the (clip,node) Stopped/Playing/Paused state machine with restart-from-0 semantics, node= subtree-root relative channel resolution (S14.2), loop/speed (S14.4) with anim_speed_max clamp, stop holds last pose + releases TRS ownership, non-loop end holds last frame + emits anim_end.
4. Ownership/conflicts (S14.5): node_busy on app TRS patch over an active playback, camera_busy vs explore both directions, node.remove auto-stop, no auto-rebind.
5. Ordering (S14.6): strict PTY receive order so upsert-then-play in one write works; play on uncommitted node = unknown_node.
6. Clock + scheduling (S14.7) + S06.5 dirty: playback sets per-node dirty flags, recomputes only the dirty subtree, re-renders only affected viewports, never bumps global scene_revision per frame, never touches asset_revision.
7. Skinning model (S14.8): parse skinned GLB with bounds checks, render bind pose ignoring joint weights, do NOT advertise feat=skin.

Every protocol surface (each verb, header field, error code, cap, lifecycle event) gets at least one unit test on the INGRESS (Parser::advance → &self accessors / pty_replies), INTERACTION (synthetic events + clock advance → camera TRS / tgp;e bytes), or LIFECYCLE (RIS/alt-screen/remove → teardown via accessors) seam, with concrete input bytes/events and concrete accessor assertions.

CROSS-CRATE apc_end BACK-CHANNEL: the `anim` verbs and the clip-id ack both depend on the foundation-phase change where toastty-parser's `Perform::apc_end` becomes outcome-bearing (returns/forwards a parsed-frame result Term turns into queued tgp;a/tgp;x bytes). P4 does NOT re-do that plumbing; tasks P4-T3/T4/T7 explicitly depend on it (cross-phase dep apc_end-backchannel) and exercise it for anim acks/errors and the clip-id ack.

CROSS-PHASE DEPENDENCIES (task ids from sibling phases, referenced as depends_on): scene-model (nodes/TRS/world-matrix/NodeKind/dirty — S06) = SCENE-MODEL; asset/wire GLB import + asset.add commit + `a` ack + asset_revision = ASSET-ADD and ACK-FRAME; tgp_scene() accessor + pty_replies + token namespacing + tgp;x error framing/closed enum = TGP-FOUNDATION and ERROR-FRAME; apc_end outcome back-channel = APC-END-BACKCHANNEL; deterministic injectable clock = CLOCK (interactivity phase); CPU pick + event emission (tgp;e) + sub/focus gating = PICK and EVENT-EMIT; explore controller + camera node ownership = EXPLORE. P4-T0 provides a local fallback to introduce the injectable clock into the TGP subsystem if the interactivity phase has not yet landed it, so P4 is buildable/testable standalone.

tasks.title: Inject the deterministic monotonic clock into the TGP subsystem
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/clock.rs (new): a `Clock` abstraction — `trait MonotonicClock { fn now(&self) -> Instant }` plus `ManualClock` (test) and `WallClock` (prod), or a thin `TgpClock(Instant)` newtype with `advance(Duration)` for tests, mirroring the existing rgp `tick_animations(now: Instant)` pattern. Wire a single clock handle into the TGP scene state owned by Term (toastty-term/src/term.rs). Add `Term::tgp_now()` / `Term::tgp_advance_clock(Duration)` test hooks and a `Term::tick_tgp(now: Instant)` driver mirroring `tick_rgp_animations`. This task ONLY introduces/forwards the clock seam for TGP; if the interactivity phase (CLOCK) already added a shared clock, this task re-exports/reuses it instead of duplicating. All terminal-side TGP time (playback, seek, anim_end timing) reads from this one clock.

tests.name: manual_clock_advances_only_on_explicit_step
tests.input: Construct Term::new(24,80,0); read t0 = Term::tgp_now(); call Term::tgp_advance_clock(Duration::from_millis(500)); read t1 = Term::tgp_now().
tests.assert: t1 - t0 == Duration::from_millis(500); a second tgp_now() with no advance returns t1 unchanged (no wall-clock drift).

tests.name: tick_tgp_with_no_playbacks_is_noop_on_revisions
tests.input: Fresh Term; capture scene_revision + asset_revision; call Term::tick_tgp(Term::tgp_now() + Duration::from_secs(1)).
tests.assert: Term::tgp_scene().scene_revision() and asset_revision() are unchanged; no per-node dirty flags set (DirtySet empty).

tasks.title: Add `alt` to the scene model (nodes, scene, viewports) with bounded validation
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/scene.rs: add `alt: Option<String>` to Node (already in S06.1 struct), and `alt: Option<String>` on Scene and Viewport. Add `validate_alt(&str) -> Result<(), TgpError>` enforcing UTF-8, ≤ alt cap (reuse max_id_bytes-class bound, 64 bytes per S13.1), and rejection of any control byte (0x00–0x1F, 0x7F) or ESC (0x1B). Wire `alt` into the node.upsert sparse-merge (absent=preserve, CBOR null=clear to None, value=set per S06.1 table). Add accessors `Node::alt()`, `Scene::alt()`, `Viewport::alt()`.

tests.name: node_upsert_sets_alt
tests.input: Handshake tok=A (tgp;q;v=2;tok=A → tgp;r). Parser::advance with a node.upsert patch creating Mesh node id=mol with CBOR field alt="caffeine molecule, C8H10N4O2".
tests.assert: Term::tgp_scene().node("A","mol").alt() == Some("caffeine molecule, C8H10N4O2"); a tgp;a ack for the txn is queued in pty_replies.

tests.name: alt_only_upsert_bumps_no_revision_no_dirty
tests.input: Create node id=mol (any kind). Capture scene_revision/asset_revision and the node's transform/visibility dirty flags. Send a second node.upsert touching only alt="x".
tests.assert: scene_revision and asset_revision both unchanged after the alt-only upsert; node's per-node dirty flags remain clear (alt never affects rendering/dirty/revisions per S13.1).

tests.name: alt_clear_via_cbor_null
tests.input: Create node with alt="label". Send node.upsert with CBOR null for alt key.
tests.assert: Term::tgp_scene().node(...).alt() == None.

tests.name: alt_over_cap_rejects_whole_txn_bad_param
tests.input: node.upsert creating node id=n1 AND node id=n2 in one txn, where n1.alt is a 65-byte ASCII string (over the 64-byte cap).
tests.assert: A tgp;x;code=bad_param is queued (detail names alt); NEITHER n1 nor n2 exists in tgp_scene() — whole txn rejected, scene unchanged (S13.1).

tests.name: alt_with_esc_byte_rejects_bad_param
tests.input: node.upsert with alt containing a 0x1B (ESC) byte.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=bad_param queued; node not created (these strings re-enter the host input path via AT tooling, S13.1).

tests.name: viewport_and_scene_alt_set_and_read
tests.input: Create a viewport vp=2 with alt="interactive 3D inspector"; set scene-level alt via the scene-alt op.
tests.assert: Term::tgp_scene().viewport("A",2).alt() == Some("interactive 3D inspector"); Scene::alt() == the set scene caption.

tasks.title: Surface alt-text: accessible name + cell-fallback caption via the CPU pick path
tasks.deliverable: toastty-term/src/term.rs: add accessibility surfacing accessors. `Term::viewport_accessible_name(tok, vp) -> Option<&str>` (the viewport alt). `Term::accessible_name_at_cell(line, col) -> Option<&str>` that, for a cell inside a viewport's live placeholder rect, resolves the node under that cell via the SAME CPU pick path used for events (S12.4) and returns that node's alt, falling back to the viewport alt, then None (terminal never fabricates). `Term::inline_viewport_caption(line, col)` returns the placeholder cell's accessible caption (viewport alt) so line-based readers announce the region in flow (S13.2). No GPU: all resolution is the CPU pick + cell→pixel rect math.

tests.name: cell_caption_is_viewport_alt_at_placeholder
tests.input: Create inline viewport vp=2 with alt="inspector" anchored at a known cell rect (no node under cursor cell yet). Query Term::inline_viewport_caption(line,col) for a cell inside the rect.
tests.assert: Returns Some("inspector") — the placeholder announces the viewport alt as its accessible name (S13.2).

tests.name: node_alt_resolved_under_at_cursor_cell
tests.input: Viewport vp=2 with a Mesh node O1 alt="Oxygen" framed so its world AABB projects under cell (line=3,col=5). Inject an AT cursor / query Term::accessible_name_at_cell(3,5).
tests.assert: Returns Some("Oxygen") (node alt resolved by CPU pick at that cell, S13.2); must agree with the CPU pick node id at that cell.

tests.name: unlabeled_graphic_returns_none
tests.input: Viewport vp=2 with NO alt and a node with NO alt under the queried cell.
tests.assert: Term::accessible_name_at_cell(...) returns None — terminal never fabricates a description (S13.2).

tests.name: headless_text_only_uses_cell_fallback_caption
tests.input: Mark the session text-only (no GPU / headless flag on Term); viewport vp=2 alt="inspector". Query inline_viewport_caption inside the rect.
tests.assert: Caption Some("inspector") is available with no GPU target present — the cell-level fallback caption is purely CPU-resolved (S13.2).

tasks.title: Parse glTF animation channels into AnimationClip on GLB import
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/clip.rs (new): `AnimationClip { duration: f32, channels: Vec<Channel> }`, `Channel { target_rel: NodeRelPath, path: TrsPath (T|R|S), sampler: Sampler }`, `Sampler { interp: Interp (Step|Linear|CubicSpline), times: Vec<f32>, values: Vec<f32> }`. Add a glTF-animation parser in toastty-graphics/src/tgp/glb_loader.rs (mirror existing rgp/glb_loader.rs) that reads `animations[]` with their channels/samplers and resolves each channel target to a relative node path within the imported hierarchy (NOT a global node id — see S14.2). Bounds-check all keyframe arrays against caps. CUBICSPLINE stores in/out tangents. Pure CPU; no GPU.

tests.name: glb_with_one_clip_parses_channels
tests.input: asset.add a minimal GLB (b64) containing one animation: a single LINEAR rotation channel on the root joint, duration 1.0s. Parser::advance the asset.add (more=0).
tests.assert: After commit, Term::tgp_scene().clip_table("A") has exactly one AnimationClip; its duration == 1.0; channels[0].path == R, interp == Linear, target_rel resolves to the root joint.

tests.name: step_and_cubicspline_interp_preserved
tests.input: asset.add a GLB whose clip has one STEP translation channel and one CUBICSPLINE scale channel.
tests.assert: clip.channels contains a Step T channel and a CubicSpline S channel; CubicSpline sampler stores 3 values per keyframe (in-tangent, value, out-tangent).

tests.name: glb_with_no_animations_yields_empty_clip_table
tests.input: asset.add a static GLB (no animations[]).
tests.assert: Term::tgp_scene().clip_table("A") is empty; asset commits normally (asset_revision bumped once).

tests.name: oversized_keyframe_array_rejected_cap_exceeded
tests.input: asset.add a GLB whose animation sampler exceeds a keyframe/cap bound.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=cap_exceeded queued citing the asset id; no clip registered, asset not committed (bounded, no crash — G8 fuzz oracle).

tasks.title: Auto-register clips on asset.add and return glTF-index→ClipId mapping in the `a` ack
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/scene.rs: on asset.add commit, allocate one `ClipId (u32)` per parsed AnimationClip in the creating token's id namespace (alongside asset/material ids), store in `Scene.clips` keyed by (token, ClipId). Build a glTF-animation-index → ClipId mapping. toastty-term/src/term.rs (or wire/ack module): include that mapping in the asset's commit `a` ack (correlator = asset id, tagged tok=). NO separate clip.add op exists. CROSS-CRATE: the ack is emitted through the apc_end outcome back-channel (APC-END-BACKCHANNEL) — apc_end forwards the committed asset outcome (including the clip mapping) to Term which formats the tgp;a bytes into pty_replies.

tests.name: asset_add_returns_clip_id_mapping_in_ack
tests.input: Handshake tok=A. asset.add (more=0) a GLB carrying two animations. Drain pty_replies.
tests.assert: A tgp;a frame is queued with tok=A and the asset correlator, carrying clip ids for glTF anim indices 0 and 1 (e.g. clip0=<id0>;clip1=<id1>); Term::tgp_scene().clip_table("A") contains exactly those two ClipIds.

tests.name: clip_ids_are_token_namespaced
tests.input: Two handshaked tokens A and B each asset.add a GLB with one animation.
tests.assert: B's anim;play against A's clip id draws tgp;x;code=denied (clip ids are scoped to the creating token, S14.1 / G1); A's own ack and B's own ack each cite only their own clip ids.

tests.name: ack_available_without_subscription
tests.input: Handshaked tok=A with NO event sub. asset.add a GLB with one animation.
tests.assert: The tgp;a clip-mapping ack is still queued — acks are available to any handshaked token, not gated on sub (G4).

tasks.title: node= subtree-root relative channel resolution
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/anim.rs (new): `resolve_targets(clip, subtree_root_node_id, scene) -> ResolvedTargets`. For each clip channel, resolve its relative target path against the subtree rooted at `node=` (by relative id/index within the imported hierarchy, S14.2). A channel whose relative target resolves to no node under `node=` is SKIPPED (animates nothing). If NO channel resolves to any existing target, return an error sentinel used to raise `no_targets`. Pure CPU; queryable resolved-target list for tests.

tests.name: channels_resolve_relative_to_subtree_root
tests.input: Instantiate two copies of a rig under nodes base_a and base_b. Resolve a clip's channels against subtree root "base_a".
tests.assert: ResolvedTargets map to base_a's shoulder/elbow/wrist descendants (not base_b's); the same clip resolved against "base_b" maps to base_b's descendants — same clip, two subtrees (S14.2).

tests.name: missing_descendant_channel_is_skipped
tests.input: Resolve a clip with 4 channels against a subtree where one channel's relative target does not exist.
tests.assert: ResolvedTargets contains 3 entries (the missing one skipped, not an error); resolution succeeds.

tests.name: no_resolvable_targets_flags_no_targets
tests.input: Resolve a clip against a node= whose subtree contains none of the clip's relative targets.
tests.assert: resolve_targets returns the no-targets sentinel (the caller raises x code=no_targets, S14.2).

tasks.title: Playback state machine + (clip,node) handle store on the deterministic clock
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/anim.rs: `Playback { handle: (ClipId, NodeId), state: Stopped|Playing|Paused, t: f32, started_at: Instant, loop_: bool, speed: f32, resolved: ResolvedTargets }`; `PlaybackTable` keyed by (token, ClipId, NodeId). State transitions: play(Stopped)→Playing from t=0; play(Playing|Paused)→restart from t=0; pause(Playing)→Paused holding pose; play(Paused)→restart from t=0; seek(t)→set absolute t, re-evaluate pose, keep Playing/Paused; stop→Stopped. `evaluate_pose(clip, t)` interpolates per Interp (Step/Linear/CubicSpline) and writes the resolved nodes' local TRS. Accessors: `Scene::playback(tok,clip,node) -> Option<&Playback>` exposing state + t. All time via P4-T0 clock.

tests.name: play_starts_at_t_zero_playing
tests.input: Create rig node base + clip C. Parser::advance anim;play;clip=C;node=base;loop=0;speed=1.
tests.assert: Scene::playback(A,C,"base").state == Playing and .t == 0.0.

tests.name: tick_advances_clip_time_and_pose
tests.input: anim;play C on base (1.0s LINEAR rotation clip, speed=1). Term::tgp_advance_clock(500ms); Term::tick_tgp(now).
tests.assert: playback.t == 0.5; the driven node's local rotation == LINEAR-interpolated value at t=0.5; its WORLD matrix (Term::tgp_scene().node(...).world()) reflects the rotated pose.

tests.name: play_on_playing_restarts_from_zero
tests.input: play C on base; advance 700ms + tick (t=0.7); send anim;play C on base again.
tests.assert: playback.t == 0.0 and state == Playing (restart semantics, S14.3).

tests.name: pause_holds_pose_then_play_restarts
tests.input: play C; advance 300ms+tick (t=0.3); anim;pause C base; advance 1s + tick.
tests.assert: After pause: state==Paused, t==0.3, node pose frozen at t=0.3 even after the 1s tick (no advance while paused). Then anim;play C base → t==0.0 (resume = restart, S14.3).

tests.name: seek_sets_absolute_t_without_changing_state
tests.input: pause C base at t=0.3; anim;seek;clip=C;node=base;t=0.8.
tests.assert: state stays Paused; t==0.8; node pose == pose at t=0.8 (seek scrubs while paused, S14.3).

tests.name: speed_scales_time
tests.input: anim;play C base speed=2; advance 250ms + tick.
tests.assert: playback.t == 0.5 (clip time advances at 2x wall time, S14.4).

tests.name: step_interp_holds_value_between_keys
tests.input: Clip with STEP translation keys at t=0 (x=0) and t=1 (x=10). play; advance 400ms + tick.
tests.assert: node local translate.x == 0 (STEP holds previous key, not interpolated).

tasks.title: anim control-frame ingress: parse play/pause/seek/stop + verb/field errors
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/operation.rs (or tgp/anim_frame.rs): parse `tgp;anim;tok=;<verb>;clip=<u32>;node=<id>;loop=0|1;speed=<f32>;t=<sec>`. Dispatch into the P4-T6 state machine. Errors (closed enum G3): unknown clip id → unknown_clip; node= not a committed node at process time → unknown_node (not queued, S14.6); pause/seek/stop on a (clip,node) that is not a live playback → not_playing; over-cap/non-positive speed → bad_param; no resolvable targets → no_targets; foreign-token clip/node → denied. CROSS-CRATE: anim frames are control frames (always parseable, never enter binary-read mode, S7.2); errors/acks for anim verbs route out through the apc_end outcome back-channel (APC-END-BACKCHANNEL) into pty_replies tagged tok=.

tests.name: play_unknown_clip_errors
tests.input: Handshake tok=A; node base exists; Parser::advance anim;play;clip=999;node=base.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=unknown_clip queued (tok=A); no playback created (never a silent no-op, S14.1).

tests.name: play_unknown_node_errors_not_queued
tests.input: Valid clip C; anim;play;clip=C;node=ghost where ghost is not a committed node.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=unknown_node queued; the play is NOT deferred — a later upsert of "ghost" does not start it (S14.6).

tests.name: pause_seek_stop_on_dead_playback_not_playing
tests.input: Clip C, node base exist but no live playback. Send anim;pause;clip=C;node=base (and separately seek, stop).
tests.assert: Each draws tgp;x;code=not_playing (S14.3).

tests.name: speed_over_cap_bad_param
tests.input: anim;play C base speed=99 with anim_speed_max=16.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=bad_param queued; no playback created (speed clamped to (0,anim_speed_max], S14.4).

tests.name: speed_nonpositive_bad_param
tests.input: anim;play C base speed=0 (and separately speed=-1).
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=bad_param for each (non-positive speed rejected, S14.4).

tests.name: no_targets_error
tests.input: Clip C whose channels resolve to nothing under node= picked. anim;play C node=empty_group.
tests.assert: tgp;x;code=no_targets queued; no playback (S14.2).

tests.name: upsert_then_play_same_write_succeeds
tests.input: ONE Parser::advance byte buffer containing a node.upsert creating base followed by anim;play;clip=C;node=base.
tests.assert: Playback exists and is Playing — upsert committed before play observes the scene (strict receive order, S14.6).

tests.name: distinct_clip_node_pairs_run_concurrently
tests.input: anim;play C node=base_a; anim;play C node=base_b (same clip, two subtree roots).
tests.assert: Two independent Playbacks both Playing; advancing the clock ticks both (handle = (clip,node), S14.3).

tasks.title: Playback drives per-node dirty + render scheduling (no global scene_revision spam)
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/scene.rs + anim.rs: each tick_tgp, for every Playing playback, evaluate the clip, write the affected nodes' local TRS, set those nodes' per-node transform dirty flags (DirtySet), and mark the viewport(s) containing those nodes per-viewport dirty. Recompute world matrices for only the dirty subtree (reuse S06.5 lazy walk). Do NOT bump global scene_revision per frame; NEVER touch asset_revision. Add accessors so tests can read DirtySet membership + the set of dirty viewport ids after a tick.

tests.name: tick_sets_only_driven_node_dirty
tests.input: Scene with driven node base (in subtree) and an unrelated node other. play C on base; advance 100ms + tick.
tests.assert: DirtySet contains base (transform dirty) and NOT other; only base's subtree world matrices recomputed.

tests.name: tick_does_not_bump_scene_or_asset_revision
tests.input: play C on base; capture scene_revision + asset_revision; advance 100ms + tick (repeat 5 ticks).
tests.assert: scene_revision and asset_revision are BOTH unchanged across all 5 ticks (playback never bumps global revisions, S14.7 / G9).

tests.name: tick_marks_only_affected_viewport_dirty
tests.input: Two viewports vp=1 (root contains base) and vp=2 (different root). play C on base; tick.
tests.assert: Per-viewport dirty set == {1}; vp=2 not marked dirty (re-render only affected viewports, S14.7).

tests.name: tick_does_not_reemit_text_cells
tests.input: Print text into the grid; play C on base; tick.
tests.assert: Text-cell damage set is unchanged by the tick (playback does not re-emit unrelated cells, S14.7).

tasks.title: Non-loop end holds last frame + emits anim_end; loop wraps and never emits
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/anim.rs: in the tick, when a non-looping playback's t reaches/exceeds clip.duration, clamp pose to the final frame, transition Playing→Stopped, RELEASE TRS ownership of its driven nodes (leave them at the final pose, no snap-to-bind), and emit an optional `anim_end` event to the owning token if subscribed (S14.4). A looping playback wraps t modulo duration and NEVER emits anim_end. CROSS-CRATE: anim_end is a tgp;e event emitted through the EVENT-EMIT path (token-tagged, focus/sub-gated, into pty_replies).

tests.name: nonloop_end_holds_last_frame_and_stops
tests.input: 1.0s clip, loop=0. play; advance 1.2s + tick.
tests.assert: playback state == Stopped; driven node pose == final-frame pose (NOT bind/identity); TRS ownership released so a subsequent node.upsert of a TRS field on that node SUCCEEDS (no node_busy).

tests.name: nonloop_end_emits_anim_end_when_subscribed
tests.input: Handshake tok=A; sub for anim_end on the playback's viewport/node. play 1.0s clip loop=0; advance 1.0s + tick.
tests.assert: A tgp;e;ev=anim_end (tok=A, node=base) is queued in pty_replies exactly once.

tests.name: nonloop_end_no_event_when_not_subscribed
tests.input: Handshaked tok=A with NO anim_end sub. play 1.0s loop=0; advance 1.0s + tick.
tests.assert: No tgp;e queued; playback still Stopped with last frame held (event is optional, S14.4).

tests.name: looping_clip_wraps_no_anim_end
tests.input: 1.0s clip loop=1. play; advance 1.3s + tick.
tests.assert: playback state == Playing; t == 0.3 (wrapped modulo 1.0); NO anim_end ever queued across multiple wraps (S14.4).

tasks.title: stop releases ownership + holds last pose; pause holds + retains ownership
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/anim.rs: `stop` transitions to Stopped, leaves driven nodes at last-evaluated pose, releases TRS ownership (clears the busy-flag on those nodes), and emits an optional ack/event. `pause` holds the current pose AND retains ownership (nodes stay busy). Add `Scene::node_trs_owner(tok,node) -> Option<(ClipId,NodeId)>` accessor exposing which playback owns a node's TRS (None == app-owned).

tests.name: stop_holds_last_pose_and_releases_ownership
tests.input: play C base; advance 400ms+tick (t=0.4, some pose P); anim;stop;clip=C;node=base.
tests.assert: state == Stopped; node local TRS == pose P (held, not reset); Scene::node_trs_owner(A,"base") == None (released).

tests.name: pause_retains_ownership
tests.input: play C base; advance 200ms+tick; anim;pause C base.
tests.assert: state == Paused; Scene::node_trs_owner(A,"base") == Some((C,"base")) (pause holds AND retains, S14.3).

tests.name: stop_then_app_patch_succeeds
tests.input: play C base; stop; then node.upsert setting base.trs to a new translate.
tests.assert: node.upsert commits (no node_busy); base.trs == the app-set value (app regained control after stop, S14.5).

tasks.title: Ownership conflict: node_busy on app TRS patch over an active playback
tasks.deliverable: toastty-graphics/src/tgp/operation.rs (patch apply): when a node.upsert writes a TRS field of a node whose TRS is owned by an active (Playing|Paused) playback, reject the WHOLE txn with x code=node_busy, scene unchanged. Upserts of NON-TRS fields (visible, tint, material ref, alt) on a played node are unaffected and commit. Enforce against the P4-T10 ownership map.

tests.name: trs_patch_over_playing_node_rejected_node_busy
tests.input: play C base (Playing). node.upsert setting base.trs (new rotation).

tasks.title: Camera ownership: camera_busy vs explore (both directions)
